workContent:
Join Deloitte China

Deloitte China provides integrated professional services to our clients with a one-stop shop offering of world-leading audit, tax, and consulting services.

•	We are the world's largest professional services firm that changes the world, leading with purpose and shared values. 
•	We are market leader in digital and innovative solutions, creating value for client through our multi-disciplinary services.
•	We are certified as one of the ‘Best Workplaces™ in Greater China and recognized as a Top Employer in China by the Top Employers Institute* since 2006！

Audit & Assurance

At Deloitte, meeting your expectations is where our Audit & Assurance services begin. By bringing bright minds, effective processes, and world-class technologies from across our global organization while drawing on our years of experience, we push ourselves to deliver an impact beyond your expectations.

Deloitte’s Audit business includes independent External Audit services where the objective is to attest or to express an opinion as to whether the financial statements give a true and fair view in all material respects, in accordance with the identified financial reporting framework. Our External Audits deliver insights that help our clients better understand how to address risks and enhance business management and financial processes and controls. We bring together the diverse skills and industry experience of our people with our leading-edge technology, to deliver high-quality audits of financial statements and internal controls over financial reporting.

Deloitte’s Assurance business leverages our professional accounting, controls and corporate reporting expertise to deliver assurance and related advisory services on both financial and non-financial information. 

Our Assurance and related advisory services are focused on engagements related to Accounting & Reporting, Controls, and Sustainability & Emerging Assurance (including AI Assurance). We bring together the diverse skills and industry experience of our people across our global network, with our leading-edge technology, to deliver high-quality assurance reports and valuable advice and insights across the corporate reporting landscape.

Financial Quant Team

We are committed to serving the large commercial banks and top-tier non-bank financial institutions with a focus on analytics and data enabled client-centric intelligence and strategies advisory, solutions addressing client risk and compliance issues, modelling, and innovative solutions integrating most advanced technologies and data enablement. We help our clients uncover creative insights to tackle complex challenges and unleash growth potentials. Our services are focused on customer analytics and credit risk related models development and validation for corporate and personal banking customers, comprehensive risk capital stress tests, capital management, trading conduct risk management, green finance and ESG risk management, model risk management, digital enabled risk management, applications of AI to enable risk and growth management and business operations, and Global Systematically Important Banks (GSIBs) / Domestic Systematically Important Banks (DSIBS) related domain services.
Within the Financial Quant Team, our Financial Risk Management practice serves as the firm's center of excellence for valuation audit and review. We specialize in complex fair value measurement (IFRS 13), impairment testing (IAS 36 / IFRS 9 ECL), purchase price allocation (IFRS 3), and share-based payment valuation (IFRS 2) — delivering independent, audit-grade analysis to the largest financial institutions in China and across the global Deloitte network. Our team combines deep quantitative expertise with AI-powered analytics to help clients and audit teams navigate the most challenging valuation and risk management issues.

Work you'll do: 

You will have the opportunity to participate in the innovative risk management solution design and services providing for the Tier 1 and Tier 2 banks and top non-bank financial institutions:

•	Develop and validate credit risk rating models and strategies by using statistics, big data analytics, machine learning algorithms, application of AI solution, and design industry-leading model application solutions for the intelligent risk control and regulatory compliance related domains for top financial institutions
•	Assist clients on innovative solutions in frontier business fields such as ESG and climate risk management, risk data platform, digital enabled next-gen risk management solutions for the top financial institutions
•	Provide regulatory compliance services in risk data aggregation and reporting, recovery and resolution plans, overseas regulatory compliance, etc. for the GSIBs / DSIBs
•	Perform independent valuation audit reviews of financial instruments — including derivatives, unlisted equity investments, structured products, and Level 3 fair value assets — applying IFRS 13 fair value hierarchy, market approach, income approach (DCF), and option pricing models to challenge management's assumptions and methodologies
•	Review and independently validate Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9, including PD/LGD/EAD parameter benchmarking, staging assessment, macroeconomic scenario analysis, and model governance evaluation for major banking and financial institution clients
•	Support AI governance and AI model assurance engagements, including AI system risk assessment, model validation, and AI audit methodology development for financial institutions adopting Generative AI and machine learning solutions

You are also expected to: 

•	Gain experience in dynamic, cross cultural, and cross functional cooperations: you will work closely with teams from different business units, with differed cultural background, and or diverse professional competencies in Deloitte to provide leading edge solutions for large banks or top tier financial institutions
•	Have opportunities to cooperate with global teams in the Deloitte network in our focused professional services domains 
•	Become a contributor and gain first-hand experience to the banking industry leading practice: you can provide solutions for top banks, understand the evolution of best practices in the industry, and contribute actively to the advancement of the industry in risk management
•	Further personal and career growth: you will be enabled to have a clearly defined career development path, with competitive personal and financial growth; equipped with cutting edge training platforms and programs, and a well-defined annual evaluation promotion mechanism to help you advance your professional competencies and pursue your career visions.
•	Gain exposure to cutting-edge valuation methodologies and AI-enabled audit tools: you will work with proprietary valuation models, Python-based analytics frameworks, and GenAI-powered review platforms that are reshaping how audit and assurance services are delivered to the world's largest financial institutions
serviceCondition:
•	A bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Economics, Management Science, Statistics, Math, Physics, Computer Science, EE, and other STEM majors 
•	Passion in helping clients solving problems and achieve win-win.
•	Strong interests in application of advanced technologies such AI to enable business growth, digital transformation, data analysis, quantitative model development, and financial risk management.
•	Possess solid theoretical expertise in mathematical statistics, econometrics and machine learning. Demonstrate strong programming proficiency to deliver end-to-end big data analytics, visualization and model development. 
•	FRM or CFA or CQF certified candidates preferred.
•	Being a team-player and a fast learner, with excellent interpersonal, communication, and time management skills, and the ability to team work, work under pressure and adherence to project deadlines.
•	Knowledge of or strong interest in financial valuation methodologies (DCF, comparable company analysis, and option pricing models) and familiarity with IFRS 13 / IFRS 9 / IAS 36 is a plus.
•	Experience with AI/ML tools or Python-based data analysis is highly desirable; curiosity about applying AI to financial services audit, valuation review, and risk management.

At Deloitte, we know we’re at our best when we look out for one another; prioritize respect, fairness, development and wellbeing; foster an inclusive culture and embrace diversity in all forms. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background, experience, identity, ability or thinking style, and if you need assistance or accommodation during the application process for accessibility reasons this is available upon request. The preferred candidate will be subject to background screening by Deloitte or by their external third-party provider.
